enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Remains still. Breathes. Opens eyes briefly. Closes eyes. Turns to right side. Remains still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Stretches arms. Yawns. Sits up. Swings legs over side of bed. Puts feet on floor. Stands up. Walks to door. Opens door.

Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Spits into sink. Rinses mouth with water. Puts down toothbrush. Washes face with water. Dries face with towel. Turns off light.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs. Takes out milk. Takes out bread. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out frying pan. Closes cupboard. Opens drawer. Takes out spatula. Closes drawer. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Scrambles eggs with spatula. Toasts bread. Pours milk into glass. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk.

Leaves house. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Swipes card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to door. Exits bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building. Walks to elevator. Presses button.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at desk. Sits down. Turns on computer. Logs in. Reviews patient files. Makes phone calls. Talks to colleagues. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Uses computer. Walks to patient rooms. Checks vital signs. Administers medication. Updates records. Eats lunch. Returns to desk. Types on keyboard. Answers phone. Writes notes. Logs out.

Leaves workplace. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Swipes card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to door. Exits bus. Walks to home. Enters house. Closes door. Removes shoes.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out meat. Takes out sauce. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot. Closes cupboard. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Cuts vegetables. Adds oil to pot. Adds vegetables to pot. Adds meat to pot. Adds sauce to pot. Stirs with spoon. Eats dinner. Washes dishes. Turns off light.

Enters living room. Turns on TV. Picks up remote. Sits on couch. Changes channels. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Stands up. Goes to kitchen. Returns with snack. Sits down. Eats snack. Watches TV. Changes channel. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up. Exits living room.

Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens browser. Types on keyboard. Uses mouse. Checks email. Watches videos. Types. Clicks. Stands up. Gets water. Sits down. Continues. Opens new tab. Types search query. Logs out. Turns off computer. Stands up. Exits living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with fan and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on light. Turns on fan. Turns on TV. Sits on bed. Picks up remote. Changes channels. Watches TV. Adjusts fan speed. Lies down. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Turns off fan. Turns off light. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes slowly.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel. Puts on pajamas. Brushes teeth. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.
Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes. Turns to other side. Pulls blanket. Remains still. Breathes.
